findings.title: Task 5 (goal-assessor citation validation, #24) is entirely absent from the reviewed diff
findings.detail: None of task 5's required changes appear anywhere in wave-0.s1.a1.diff: no internal/finish/goals.go CheckCitations addition, no internal/cli/cmd_record.go readVerdicts root-param wiring, no internal/brief/templates/goal-assessor.md grammar update, and neither new test file (internal/finish/goals_test.go additions, internal/cli/citations_test.go) is present. Requirement coverage for task 5 is 0% in this diff. (For context: docs/takt/sweep-the-open-issue-backlog-fix-the/waves/0/task-5.a1.digest.json records the task-5 attempt as status "blocked" — the implementer reports the core work complete but blocked on a pre-existing fixture in the undeclared file internal/cli/cmd_record_test.go citing a.go:1 in a repo with no a.go — which is presumably why it did not land in this wave's diff. The corresponding code does already exist in the working tree at internal/finish/goals.go:142 (CheckCitations) and internal/cli/cmd_record.go:222, but that is not part of the diff being reviewed here and the task is not marked done.)
